content:
The official Amazon fall Prime Day sale is now flying with millions of price drops, and some particularly notable Apple deals. Alongside one of the best prices ever on AirPods Pro 3 and $120 off AirPods Max 2, we are also tracking new all-time low prices on several Apple Watch Series 12 models and nearly $100 off Ultra 4. Those offers also join the lowest prices to date on the M6 Mac mini lineup at up to $150 off, a solid $200 price drop on the new Mac Studio, and the best prices in months on the M5 MacBook Air lineup at $200 off. Head below for a closer look as well as deals on the brand new Magic Keyboard, chargers, Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro cases, more.

Hello! AirPods Pro 3 just dropped to one of the best prices ever at $179 for fall Prime Day (Reg. $249), AirPods Max 2 now $120 off

Heads up folks, Amazon is now offering one of the best prices ever on Apple’s AirPods Pro 3 at $179 – fall Prime Day is truly getting off to an early start this year.

Amazon is now offering the latest AirPods Pro 3 down at $179 shipped. Regularly $249, this is a solid $70 off the list price and easily one of the lowest prices we have ever tracked.

  • AirPods Pro 3 $179 (Reg. $249) – one of the best prices ever
  • AirPods Max 2 $429 (Reg. $549)

Apple did just release the all-new AirPods 5, but AirPods Pro 3 remain the flagship, top-of-the-line option, delivering better battery life, as much as 3x better active noise cancellation, built-in hearty rate sensing, and more.

The new AirPods 5 with ANC and the Wireless Charging Case carry a $149 list price, but you can now score the Pro set for just $30 more as part of this early Prime Day sale.

Heads up! Apple’s brand new M6 Mac mini just dropped to the lowest prices ever at up to $150 off

The brand new M6 Mac mini as well as the high-end M5 Max model have now dropped to all-time low prices at up to nearly $150 off. The Apple deals are flying now with AirPods Pro 3 and AirPods Max 2 already at some of the lowest prices ever, and, surprisingly enough, Apple’s brand new Mac mini is landing with a serious discount starting today.

While we did catch some light $20 launch discounts on the mini lineup, today we are getting the first proper discounts at up to nearly $150 off to deliver the lowest prices ever:

  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/256GB $780 (Reg. $899) – All-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 16GB/512GB $950 (Reg. $1,099) – All-time low
  • 2026 M6 Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,150 (Reg. $1,299) – All-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac mini 24GB/512GB $1,550 (Reg. $1,699) – All-time low
  • 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio $2,300 (Reg. $2,499) – All-time low

All configurations Amazon sells, outside of the 24GB M6 model, have now dropped to Amazon all-time low pricing. You’re looking at just shy of $120 off on the base and most affordable model, and just under $150 off for the upgraded 16GB/512GB as well as the 24GB M5 Max chip-equipped setup.

Official Apple Watch Series 12 Prime Day deals now live, new all-time lows from $350

As part of the live 2026 Amazon fall Prime Day sale, and joining AirPods Pro 3 at one of the best prices ever, Amazon is now offering loads more Apple Watch Series 12 models at all-time low pricing – we also catching the very first proper deal on the new high-end ceramic model at $50 off as well.

Apple Watch Series 12 fall Prime Day deals

Outside of the early $10 pre-order and launch discounts, the fall Prime Day deals we now have are indeed the first truly notable discounts on the brand new Series 12 lineup, delivering all-time low pricing and the best chance for folks to upgrade since release:
